title: 945. Regions Cut by Slashes

examples.explanation: The two strokes join into one diagonal wall that splits the square into 2 zones.
A lone stroke touching the border fails to enclose anything, leaving 1 zone.
The crossing strokes carve the square into 5 separate pockets.

hints: Expand every cell into a 3x3 pixel block so diagonal walls become axis-aligned barriers.
A '/' blocks the anti-diagonal pixels and a backslash blocks the main diagonal pixels.
Count connected components of the remaining open pixels with flood fill.
